title: Building Your Future-You Resume, Part 1
visualCarrier: native-scale full-frame resume signal field with one moving focus window and no persistent side or footer panels
constraints: no progress, track, rail, scrubber, trace, or completion motion
no persistent sidebars, footer boxes, or decorative dashboard furniture
native 1920x1080 composition with label 20-24px, body 40-48px, subhead 54-72px, and headline 84-104px
one complete visual scene per sentence or tightly connected idea
each illustration explains the narrated point

Resolve the decision-maker test: right fit, right now.
Flip the frame from proving busyness to showing readiness.
Use the next move as the filter for projects, results, and responsibilities.
Emphasize leadership, outcomes, and scope while de-emphasizing irrelevant tasks.
Use the Next Move Statement as the north star.
Select three to five experiences and apply responsibility, action, measurable outcome, and scope.
Rewrite one task bullet into a measurable impact bullet.
Show the Resume Builder Tool workflow and headline-story choice.
